sloka: वाङ्मात्रेण तदा राजा कैकेय्या स्ववशे कृतः ।प्रच्स्कन्द विनाशाय पाशं वृग इवात्मनः ॥२-११-२२॥
transliteration: vāṅmātreṇa tadā rājā kaikeyyā svavaśe kṛtaḥ ।pracskanda vināśāya pāśaṁ vṛga ivātmanaḥ ॥2-11-22॥

translations.english: The king now came under the control of Kaikeyi by his own words like a deer that jumps into the trap for its own destruction.
